name: PODZO
tagline: AI-Powered Enterprise Logistics Execution & Siding Dispatch
useCase: Autonomous siding dispatch, weighbridge tare/gross match, and Proof-of-Delivery across the Order-to-Cash (O2C) lifecycle.
problem: Manual railcar siding allocation causes congestion and rail demurrage penalties.
Weighbridge paper slips and physical POD delivery notes take 4-7 days to be manually verified and keyed into SAP.
Discrepancies between physical dispatch gross weight and sales orders delay customer billing and trigger payment disputes.
solution: Autonomous Siding Dispatch: Dynamically allocates siding capacity based on active S/4HANA Sales Orders (VA03).
Computer Vision OCR: Extracts stamps, signatures, and tare/gross weights from physical PODs with 99.2% extraction accuracy.
Deterministic 3-Way Match: Automatically cross-checks weighbridge data against outbound delivery notes (VL03N) and triggers instant MIRO settlement.

Statutory tax code mismatches lead to lost input tax credits and regulatory compliance audit penalties.
solution: Multi-Channel Ingestion: Normalizes invoices from email, EDI, and portal into a unified canonical JSON schema.
Deterministic Context Binding: Live validation against S/4HANA purchasing org, vendor tax IDs, and payment terms.
Cognitive Exception Routing: Categorizes price vs. quantity variances and routes edge breaks directly to designated buyers.

name: RECONLY

solution: Universal Statement Parser: Ingests vendor statements in PDF, Excel, and scan formats regardless of layout variation.
Automated Line-Item Matcher: Matches statement transactions against live SAP S/4HANA open items (BSEG/BSAK).
Discrepancy Categorization: Automatically flags missing invoices, credit note disputes, and timing lags.

name: AIS ABAP & CDS AI Debug Studio
tagline: SAP ADT Automation, MCP & 1-Click Code Auto-Repair
useCase: Turning SAP short dumps, ABAP source, and CDS activation errors into plain-English diagnosis and live 1-click repairs pushed via ADT.
problem: Senior developers waste hours diagnosing complex ST22 runtime dumps (zerodivide, timeout, null pointer).
Reproducing errors in quality environments is difficult when data-dependent variables are not clearly documented.
Manual code fixes risk introducing regressions or violating Clean ABAP cloud-ready programming standards.
solution: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: Connects LLM agents directly to live SAP ADT REST endpoints on BTP CF eu10.
ST22 Dump Cognitive Diagnostic: Translates raw kernel dumps into plain-English explanations with line-level failure pinpointing.
1-Click AI Code Repair: Generates Clean ABAP patches with boundary guards and pushes them directly to open SAP transport requests.

name: SAP Joule Copilot & Autonomous Skills
tagline: Autonomous Operational Execution Copilot Embedded in Build Work Zone
useCase: Transforming SAP Joule from a passive conversational search bot into an autonomous operational execution copilot.
problem: Business users must navigate across dozens of disparate Fiori apps and legacy GUI transactions to complete simple tasks.
Standard conversational assistants cannot execute operational write-backs into SAP backend systems.
Direct database manipulation by conversational bots introduces extreme data corruption and audit violation risks.
solution: Persistent Floating Copilot: Embedded directly into the SAP Build Work Zone header across all enterprise workspaces.
Zero Direct DB Manipulation: All conversational actions execute strictly through authenticated Cloud Foundry REST services.
Enterprise RBAC Enforcement: Inherits user authorizations, ensuring users cannot trigger actions beyond their SAP security profile.
